title: Reviewing & Deploying the AWS Tree Discovery Templates in AWS

blocks.text: After Completing Configuration in Zscaler, you must do the following to successfully integrate your accounts:

blocks.item: 1. Review & Deploy the Tree Discovery templates in AWS
The deployment mode varies based on the type of role creation chosen during Configuration Creation Mode:
Automated Role Creation
In the Review & Deploy page, select one of the following:
Download Template
To download all displayed templates to your local machine. The templates displayed vary based on the selected options.
Deploy the CloudFormation template in AWS.
Sign in to the AWS Management Console and go to CloudFormation.
In the left-side navigation, select Stacks.
Click Create stack.
On the Create stack page:
Prepare template: Select Template is ready.
Specify template: Select Upload a template file to upload the template you downloaded from the AI Security Admin Portal
Upload a template file: Click Choose file, browse and select template, then click Open.
Click Next.
On the Specify stack details page, under Stack name, enter a unique stack name.
Click Next.
On the Configure stack options page, click Next.
On the Review and create page, under Capabilities, select the I acknowledge checkbox to acknowledge AWS CloudFormation's creation of IAM resources with custom names.
Click Submit.
Deploy the Terraform template in AWS.
Update the backend.tf file with the name of the storage services where you want to store the Terraform state files. For example:
bucket: Enter the name of the S3 bucket.
region: Enter the region.
dynamodb_table: Enter the name of the dynamoDB table.
Open the Command Prompt or any other CLI app in your local system.
Switch to the directory that contains the Terraform template.
Copy and paste the access keys of the target account and press Enter.
Run the following commands:
To initialize the Terraform working directory:
terraform init
To verify the changes in the Terraform configuration:
terraform plan
To run the Terraform script:
terraform apply
For Do you want to perform these actions?, enter yes and press Enter.
Quick Deploy
You are redirected to the AWS Portal. Ensure you have logged into the correct Management Account.
Copy the External ID that is generated in the AI Security console.
Paste the copied text into the External ID field in the AWS Portal, under CloudFormation > Stacks > Quick create stack.
See image.
Click Save.
See image.
Click Save & Complete Onboarding to complete the onboarding.
Manual Role Creation
The Validate Manual Configuration page displays the Tree Discovery Role and Asset Discovery Role details.
See image.
After you have reviewed and validated the details, click Save & Complete Onboarding. If validation fails, you can update the role names, External ID, or trust policy and re-validate
2. Validate the integration in Zscaler
After deploying all CloudFormation templates, validate the integration in the Zscaler console.
Log back into the AI Security Admin Portal.
Go to Administration > Account Onboarding.
Locate the AWS Organization integration in the list. If the Health shows Healthy (green), the integration is validated and no further action is required.
If the status has not yet been updated, click on the integration to open the Overview page.
Click Manage (top-right) and select On-Demand Validation.
To validate individual accounts within the organization, navigate to the Accounts tab and run On-Demand Validation for each account.
